prompt: A cleric in white-and-gold robes kneels beside a wounded soldier sprawled on the ground in dented steel plate, her hands extended over his bleeding chest wound as a stream of warm white-gold healing radiance pours from her palms and the gash visibly knits shut, the soldier's face slack with relief. The only source of light in the scene is the soft golden healing glow from her hands. The background is a dim battlefield at dusk, trampled mud and broken spears.

A wounded warrior in tattered chainmail kneels alone, head tilted up and eyes closed in relief, bathed from above in a single brilliant shaft of warm white-gold holy light, the crepuscular ray striking his bloodied shoulder where the wound is glowing and closing over. The only source of light in the scene is that descending golden beam. The background is the dark interior of a ruined stone chapel, broken arches in deep shadow.

A radiant angelic figure made of white-gold light hovers in the air, wings spread, one hand outstretched downward pouring a beam of warm healing radiance onto a collapsed wounded peasant lying on the ground below, the peasant's body softly glowing as life returns. The only source of light is the angel's golden glow, haloing both figures. The background is a darkened village square at night, both figures fully visible.

Low worm's-eye view from the ground looking up at a wounded woman in torn linen lying on her back, both arms reaching up into a warm white-gold beam of healing light streaming down onto her, the deep gash across her ribs glowing bright gold as it visibly closes, her face turned up and mouth open in gasping relief. The only source of light is the descending golden radiance. The background is a dark night sky scattered with faint stars above her.

Two figures, both fully visible head to foot: a white-robed cleric kneeling in profile facing right, both hands pressed gently to the chest wound of a wounded knight lying on his back in steel plate. A burst of brilliant white-gold healing light erupts from the point of contact where the wound is sealing shut, casting golden rim-light on both faces. The only source of light is that healing burst. The background is a quiet stone courtyard at night.

A paladin in polished silver plate kneels over a fallen comrade at dawn, pressing one gauntleted hand to the comrade's gashed thigh, warm white-gold healing radiance spilling from beneath the gauntlet as the wound glows and closes. Soft pink-gold dawn light rims the scene. The background is a grassy hillside battlefield at first light, pale sky and scattered dropped shields.

Extreme close-up of two weathered cupped human hands cradling a glowing orb of warm white-gold healing light, soft golden rays leaking between the fingers, tiny motes of light rising from the orb like fireflies. The only source of light is the radiant orb, casting a warm glow up onto the hands and wrists. The background is deep soft shadow, out of focus.

Two figures, both fully visible head to foot: a white-robed cleric kneeling in profile facing right, both hands pressed gently to the chest of a wounded knight lying on his back in dark steel plate, his face visible and slack with relief. A single brilliant white-gold healing star bursts from the point of contact where the wound is sealing shut, the brightest thing in the frame, casting golden rim-light on both faces. The only source of light is that healing burst. The background is a quiet stone courtyard at night.
